description: UI layer — AppLensProvider context, shared components, the floating trigger button, the full-screen modal with manual tab navigation, and all six tab screens (Overview, Network, NetworkDetail, Console, Events, Settings). Depends on FEAT-001 for types and AppLens singleton. Independent of FEAT-003 (AI tab content) — the AITab created here is a placeholder that FEAT-003 will fill in.
steps: Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/core/AppLensProvider.tsx — React context provider. Holds state: modalVisible (bool), activeTab (string), selectedNetworkRequest (NetworkRequest|null), selectedLogEntry (LogEntry|null). Exposes these plus setters via AppLensContext. Also subscribes to storage changes and stores networkRequests[], logs[], events[] in component state so tabs re-render on new data. Export AppLensProvider and useAppLens hook.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/components/Badge.tsx — small colored pill. Props: label: string, color: string (background), textColor?: string. Uses View + Text + StyleSheet. Export Badge.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/components/SearchBar.tsx — TextInput with a clear (×) button. Props: value, onChangeText, placeholder. Dark-themed (#1a1a1a background, #fff text). Export SearchBar.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/components/JSONViewer.tsx — renders an arbitrary JSON value as a formatted, scrollable Text block. Props: data: unknown, maxHeight?: number. Converts value via JSON.stringify(data, null, 2). Export JSONViewer.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/components/NetworkEntry.tsx — single row for network list. Props: request: NetworkRequest, onPress: () => void. Shows: method badge (GET=blue, POST=green, PUT=amber, DELETE=red, PATCH=purple), truncated URL, status code colored (2xx=green, 3xx=blue, 4xx=amber, 5xx=red, pending=grey), duration in ms. Export NetworkEntry.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/components/LogEntry.tsx — single row for console log list. Props: entry: LogEntry, onPress: () => void. Shows: level badge (log=grey, info=blue, warn=amber, error=red, debug=cyan), truncated message, timestamp formatted as HH:mm:ss. Export LogEntry.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/components/AppLensTrigger.tsx — floating TouchableOpacity fixed at bottom-right (position absolute, bottom 32, right 16, zIndex 9999). Shows '🔍' emoji or 'AL' text label. Semi-transparent dark background (#0d0d0dCC). On press: calls setModalVisible(true) from AppLensContext. Export AppLensTrigger.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/components/AppLensModal.tsx — full-screen RN Modal (animationType='slide', transparent=false, visible=modalVisible). Dark theme throughout (#0d0d0d background). Header row with 'AppLens' title + close (×) button. Tab bar below header: horizontal ScrollView of TouchableOpacity tab items for ['Overview','Network','Console','Events','AI','Settings']. Active tab has bottom border highlight (green #00ff88). Content area below renders the active tab component. Export AppLensModal.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/tabs/OverviewTab.tsx — summary dashboard. Shows counts: network requests, logs (breakdown by level), events. Shows last 3 of each category as preview rows. Shows AppLens config summary (which features are enabled). No search needed. Export OverviewTab.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/tabs/NetworkTab.tsx — FlatList of NetworkRequest items rendered via NetworkEntry component. Header: count + SearchBar + filter buttons (ALL, GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, ERROR) + Clear button. Tapping a row calls setSelectedNetworkRequest and navigates to NetworkDetailScreen (managed via a local 'view' state: 'list'|'detail'). Export NetworkTab.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/tabs/NetworkDetailScreen.tsx — detail view for a single NetworkRequest. Back button at top. Sections: Request (URL, method, headers table, query params parsed from URL, body via JSONViewer), Response (status, headers table, body via JSONViewer, duration), Error (if state=error: message + stack), Context (screen, hook, service, event if present). Export NetworkDetailScreen.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/tabs/ConsoleTab.tsx — FlatList of LogEntry items rendered via LogEntry component. Header: count + SearchBar + level filter pills (ALL, LOG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, DEBUG) + Clear button. Tapping a row opens a detail modal (use a second Modal or an inline expanded view) showing full message, all args via JSONViewer, timestamp, and full stack trace. Export ConsoleTab.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/tabs/EventsTab.tsx — FlatList of AppEvent items. Header: count + SearchBar + Clear button. Each row: event name, timestamp, property count badge. Tapping a row shows full event properties via JSONViewer in an inline expand or detail panel. Export EventsTab.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/tabs/SettingsTab.tsx — scrollable list of settings rows. Each row: label on left, Switch on right. Settings: AppLens Enabled, Network Logging, Console Logging, Event Logging, AI Assistant, Persist Logs (toggle only — persisting is not implemented, just config), Verbose Logging. Reads from AppLens.getConfig(), writes back via a local state copy and calls a re-initialize-like update. Show current AI provider and model at bottom. Export SettingsTab.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/tabs/AITab.tsx — placeholder for FEAT-003. Renders a centered message 'AI tab — implemented in FEAT-003'. Export AITab so AppLensModal can import it.

Update /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/src/core/AppLensProvider.tsx to export a default <AppLens /> component (named AppLensUI) that renders both <AppLensTrigger /> and <AppLensModal /> wrapped in the AppLensProvider. This is what consumers render: <AppLens />. Update src/index.ts to export AppLensUI as 'AppLens' component export alongside the AppLens singleton.
acceptance_criteria: AppLensModal renders with 6 tabs and correct dark theme styling
NetworkTab shows requests in a FlatList with method/status/duration, supports search and method filtering
NetworkDetailScreen shows request headers, body, response, and error sections
ConsoleTab shows log entries with level badges, supports search and level filtering
SettingsTab renders all toggle rows with functional Switch components
AppLensTrigger renders as a fixed floating button that opens the modal
